content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly we need to get NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know the molecule. Maybe the system expects we request proton NMR and count methyl signals? Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give spectrum with peaks and integration? Might include methyl peaks. Could also use carbon_nmr_spectra to see number of methyl carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR. Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
